findings.label: Turnstile hostname not verified
findings.detail: verifyTurnstile accepts any success+action match. Also compare data.hostname with the site host when live keys are set.

findings.label: Notice email falls back to demo contactEmail
findings.detail: Without CONTACT_TO_EMAIL, notices go to SiteSettings.contactEmail (hello@example.org in demo data). Skip and log when the recipient is empty or example.org, or list CONTACT_TO_EMAIL as required in the go-live checklist.

findings.label: Turnstile error not associated with a control
findings.detail: The prayer-/contact-turnstile-error FieldError ids are referenced by no aria-describedby. Point the widget group at them.

findings.label: Unpublish of nothing still audits
findings.detail: unpublishPrayer/unpublishTestimony on a missing id succeed and write { removed: 0 }. Consider returning NOT_FOUND.
